cohort: Newborns admitted to the neonatal care unit of the Department of Paediatrics at Meenakshi Mission Hospital and Research Centre (MMHRC), Madurai, India, over 18 months from August 2013 to January 2015.
finding: The prevalence of congenital malformations was 7.7%, with cardiovascular anomalies being the most common (45.74%), followed by digestive system (23.32%), genitourinary (20.51%), and musculoskeletal system (11.21%) anomalies.
